subject: E-Commerce
title: Packaging Waste Crisis
description: A micro-lesson that makes Packaging Waste Crisis usable.

hook.text: E-commerce generates 2.1 billion pounds of packaging waste in the US alone each year.

buildup.text: Amazon ships a toothbrush in a box big enough for a laptop. Oversized packaging is the norm, not the exception.

discovery.text: Amazon's frustration-free packaging program reduced box sizes by 33%. It saves money and reduces waste simultaneously.

twist.text: Sustainable packaging often costs more than traditional materials. Compostable mailers cost 3-5x as much as plastic.

climax.text: The packaging crisis won't be solved by choice alone. Regulation—like the EU's packaging rules—may force the change.

punchline.text: Packaging Waste Crisis: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: How much did Amazon's frustration-free packaging reduce box sizes?
